PRACTICAL EXAMPLE — PIPE ABOVE A FIRE-RATED CEILING
Suppose a mechanical contractor finishes piping above a ceiling and the architectural trade wants to close the ceiling tomorrow.
You do not merely inspect the pipe.
Mechanical → piping systemMechanical → penetrationsMechanical → testingMechanical → insulationInterior Architectural → ceilingsFire/Life Safety → firestopping
Photograph the entire hidden system before ceiling closure.
Now, if there is ever a future dispute, you have evidence of what existed before concealment.
